producer_description: Apache-2.0 NetFlow v5 exporter simulator; not physical-router traffic
redistribution_basis: The exact generated NetFlow payload is redistributed as test evidence under the producer repository's Apache-2.0 license.

generation.build: go build -trimpath at the recorded commit
generation.capture: first UDP payload received by a local loopback-only qualification collector
generation.storage_encoding: lowercase hexadecimal; decoding yields the byte-identical 792-byte UDP payload

privacy_review.network_facts: Only synthetic flow fields generated by nflow-generator are present. Private and public-looking IP values are generator test data, not captured user traffic.

independent_decode.method: separate Python struct/ipaddress decoder using the published NetFlow v5 wire layout; it does not import ingestion_core
